purpose: Teach: 喜劇/白鳥/酒造/クジラ/雑学/落とし穴/飲み屋/平方メートル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと喜劇のお芝居観に行きたいわね
lines.en: Sho, would you like to go see a comedy play with your dad?
lines.style: Warm, inviting question. Soft opening. She's offering him something she thinks he might enjoy, gauging his interest without pushing. Gentle weight on the word 'would'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、白鳥の湖のバレエ観たいよ
lines.en: But Mei-san, I want to see Swan Lake instead — the ballet.
lines.style: Bright, eager child voice cutting gently across. Quick pace on 'Swan Lake.' Small, genuine excitement. No artifice, just honest wanting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと酒造の見学はもう少し大きくなってからね
lines.en: Sho, the sake brewery tour — maybe that's something for when you're a little older.
lines.style: Tender redirection. Thoughtful pause before 'maybe.' Soft, not dismissive. She's protecting something for him — a future moment. Trailing kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵本でクジラ見てワクワクしたよ
lines.en: Mei-san, I saw a whale in a picture book and it made me feel so excited!
lines.style: Small, genuine wonder in the voice. The word 'whale' gets its own space — he's still holding that feeling. Natural child rhythm, not performed. Bright but sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはお絵描きの雑学いっぱい知ってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I actually know quite a lot about art and drawing — lots of interesting facts.
lines.style: Offering knowledge like a gift. Warm but not talking down. She's inviting him into something she cares about. Modest pride underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵に落とし穴を描いたよ
lines.en: Oh! Mei-san, I drew a pitfall trap in my picture!
lines.style: Small laugh of pride underneath. Quick delivery — he wants her to know right now. The excitement of showing something he made. Slight breathlessness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが昔、飲み屋で歌を歌ったお話してたわ
lines.en: Your dad told me once — he used to sing in bars when he was younger.
lines.style: Sharing a small secret about someone he loves. Warm, conversational. She's painting a picture for him. Slight smile in the voice, remembering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お家の広さは100平方メートルくらいだって
lines.en: Mei-san, our house is about a hundred square meters, I think.
lines.style: Quiet observation. He's noticing, cataloging something concrete about his world. Slight uncertainty at the end — he's not entirely sure but it matters to him. Thoughtful child tone.
